phase_rule: First two pilot; four confirmation. Reused primary blocks are never new independent replications.
I06_paths: G binds outputs/generation/{G}.json; original D=numeric G+1. Review RG-I06-{case}-1/2 binds reviews/generation/{producer}.json. Future declarations are not evidence.

I11.expand: All six cases x nine arms x three stages:162 roles. Bit positions select necessity, construction, conversion; 0=ordinary. G uses generic three times. Each stage reads case and ALL earlier same-arm stages; preserve every intermediate ID. No compressor. Final=S3 raw.

I12.expand: Each case has four shared roles plus five arms x three roles:114 roles. O/G/I challenger=ordinary/generic/interface. C/D convergence=consensus/deferred. Challenger reads incumbent; convergence reads incumbent, identical three concerns, own challenger; D reads own convergence. Shared concerns read case independently. Incumbent has exactly one R1 or missing-seed skip of all dependent arm roles.

I13.expand: Six cases x two exact I06 raw pools x two compressors:24 roles; eight deterministic cells per case:48 views. Each compressor reads case plus assigned raw only. Reuse full generic-control assessment context under exact bindings; no new creation credit.

I10.expand: Four confirmation cases x ordinary/backcast:8 consecutive pools; original I06 D, two deterministic views each:16 views, zero native calls. Include no-opening, no-eligible and gated pools.

gates: Require completed upstream phase evidence: exact sources/terminal joins, valid complete dual assessments, locked decisions and fidelity/readiness verdicts. Presence alone fails. I13 needs completed I06 matching phase plus I10 validated view-contract readiness; confirmation additionally needs completed I10 exposure. Own pilot lock precedes confirmation. I11 no gain, lost outcome or unsupported intermediary skips confirmation. Missing/invalid/unresolved dependencies retain nulls and scheduled denominators.
execution: First save, fresh isolated context, zero scored retries.345 native ceiling; wave overhead7 separately charged once. Every role retains completed/invalid/missing/skipped disposition. Parent verification, capacity preflight and admission precede launch.
optional: Human/physical phases remain resource gated and unexecuted; no simulated humans. I10 human pilot8 participants/32 decisions, confirmation16/64; access/consent/frozen oracle required.
